haiku.problem: Not one of the passage's main questions. It asks which group came along, a minor detail. The central question, whether it is lawful to pay taxes, was left out, even though its prep card (1-6) was available.

The question uses the pronoun "Him" before naming Jesus, which breaks the rule against using a pronoun before saying who it is. It should name Jesus first, for example "tried to trap Jesus with a question about taxes."
